verdict.rationale: Box's own developer site says agents can access Box content 'through the Box CLI or the Box MCP server,' which confirms an official, first-party CLI positioned for AI-agent workflows. That is the only mention in the evidence; nothing describes its commands, installation, auth flow or output formats. missing for 10: dedicated CLI documentation (install, commands, auth), evidence of agent-friendly features such as structured/JSON output, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
